name: Distance-Aware Replication on Tangent-planes (DART)
definition: A depth-free, geometry-only augmentation of the SfM initialization that replicates each SfM point on its local tangent plane within a disk whose radius grows with distance from the scene center, adding primitives in the scene periphery where the SfM cloud is typically sparsest.
summary: DART is a deterministic geometry-only initialization that enriches sparse SfM point clouds by replicating points on tangent planes, scaling the replication radius by distance from the scene center.
